parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The lines do not intersect and are not parallel, so they are skew.

A1: correct value, possible λ=6,12,0 or μ=−9,−21,−3 depending on chosen pairs. A1: verify another component is inconsistent (examples in scheme include 21≠15, −16≠−22, or −1≠5). B1: show direction vectors (2,3,−1) and (−1,−2,1) are not scalar multiples, using at least two components; a bare assertion is insufficient. [Total: 5]
